seeds.title: spec text silent on case of prefix and suffix under lower
seeds.detail: The spec compiles only the row regexes with re.IGNORECASE under {name:lower}. The code also compares prefix and suffix without case under lower (FEATURE/proj-1-RUN-2 parses). The plan notes say this is intended. Tests TC-contract-6 and 7 pin it. Consider a spec sentence.

seeds.title: row 6 captures attempt-like tails as verify
seeds.detail: S-001-v0-x-0-attempt-4 parses as verify with profile x-0-attempt, part 4, because row 6 comes before row 7. This follows the table order. A real verify branch never ends in attempt-N, so no live name is affected.
